description: A utility module providing functions for formatting currency amounts, especially USD, with dynamic decimal precision, thousands separators, and optional credits suffix. It ensures consistent currency display across the application, with special handling for small, large, and zero values.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string with dynamic precision, optional credits suffix, and handling for various value magnitudes.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: Convenience function to format USD amount with credits appended, forwarding options to formatCurrencyAmount.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with significant decimal precision (up to 6 decimals) and thousands separators.
